'''Tev Solusar''' was the son of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Kam Solusar and Fheela, as well as the grandson of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ranik Solusar]]. According to his father, Tev was very skilled with the Force, displaying a similar aptitude for it as his father and grandfather. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Tev was hidden away with his mother and brother, [[Jaxor Solusar]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]] under Ranik Solusar's protection. In spite of this, Tev and his family were discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and, while Kam Solusar was absent, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was sent to Anoth to execute the Solusar family; the fledgling [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force user]] was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by Vader alongside his brother, mother and grandfather.

==Behind the Scenes==
Tev Solusar and his brother Jaxor Solusar were originally meant to be mentioned within the cancelled [[Lightsider (story)|''Lightsider'']] novella as part of [[Tom Veitch]]'s attempt to expand upon the time gap between ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]'' and the origins of Kam Solusar. With the unofficial digital release of [[Lightsider (story)|''Lightsider's'']] 1997 and 2009 manuscripts by writer [[Joseph Bongiorno]]<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarstimeline.net/latest_news.htm|text=Lightsider Online Release|work=StarWarsTimeline Expanded Universe News|quote="In case you missed it, here is the PDF for the Tom Veitch story, Lightsider, a lost EU work that takes place between Dark Empire I and II. Click on the title here or on the right column to download Tom Veitch's unpublished, previously lost bridge story between Dark Empires I and II" - Joseph Bongiorno.|archivedate=20231209175121}}</ref>, a major discrepancy came to light regarding the novella's placement within the [[Star Wars Legends]] timeline. Being set between ''Star Wars: Dark Empire'' and ''Star Wars: Dark Empire II'', the storyline would have taken place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], yet Kam Solusar claims that his family was murdered "thirty-five years ago" in the manuscript<ref name="Lightsider" />. This would indicate that Tev and Jaxor died in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]; however, 25 BBY was six years before Darth Vader began hunting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as part of the Great Jedi Purge.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
